note: TWICE on TV variety and reality shows — their own series (SIXTEEN) and guest runs on others, one entry per episode. Grouped by show, not by year: each show is one tab and one section. YouTube variety (TIME TO TWICE and the rest) is a separate section. A show can carry "mustWatch" and a "summary", shown on its heading.

series.label: After School Club
series.summary: Arirang TV's live K-pop show for international fans, with live video chats and tweets from viewers.

series.label: Pops in Seoul
series.summary: Arirang TV's long-running K-pop show for international viewers.

series.label: Weekly Idol
series.summary: MBC every1's idol variety show, hosted in TWICE's years on it by Jung Hyung-don and Defconn.

series.label: A Look at Myself (나를 돌아봐)
series.summary: KBS2's reality show (July 2015 – April 2016) that paired celebrities up to spend time together and look back at themselves.

series.label: Yu Huiyeol's Sketchbook
series.summary: KBS2's late-night live music talk show, hosted by Yu Hee-yeol.

series.label: Idol Star Athletics Championships (아이돌스타 선수권대회)
series.summary: MBC's holiday sports special, aired at Lunar New Year and Chuseok: idols compete in athletics, archery, rhythmic gymnastics and more. Filed one card per championship, with TWICE's clips on it.

series.label: TWICE's Elegant Private Life
series.summary: Their first reality show after debut: the members' everyday lives off stage.

series.label: Star King (스타킹)
series.summary: SBS's talent show, where ordinary people with unusual skills perform for a celebrity panel.

series.label: Kiss the Radio (키스더라디오)
series.summary: KBS Cool FM's late-night radio show, hosted by Super Junior and later by FT Island's Lee Hong-ki.

series.label: Knowing Bros
series.summary: JTBC's school-themed talk show: guests arrive as transfer students and trade games and questions with the brothers.

series.label: Running Man
series.summary: SBS's long-running race variety show: missions at landmarks, capped by the name-tag elimination game.

series.label: Chef & My Fridge (냉장고를 부탁해)
series.summary: JTBC's cooking show: star chefs race to make dishes using only what's in a guest's own fridge.

series.label: Happy Together (해피투게더)
series.summary: KBS2's long-running Thursday-night talk show.

series.label: Hit the Stage (힛 더 스테이지)
series.summary: Mnet's 2016 dance competition for idols: each performs a solo stage on the week's theme. Momo competed in Episodes 1–4.

series.label: 2 Days & 1 Night (1박 2일)
series.summary: KBS2's long-running Sunday travel variety show.

series.label: Sister's Slam Dunk
series.summary: KBS2 variety show where celebrity women chase their dreams; its first season formed the project girl group Unnies.

series.label: The Return of Superman
series.summary: KBS2's reality show following celebrity dads raising their children.

series.label: Trick & True (트릭 앤 트루)
series.summary: KBS2's science-and-magic variety show, which ran from October 2016 to February 2017.

series.label: Entertainment Weekly (연예가중계)
series.summary: KBS2's entertainment news magazine, on air from 1984 to 2019.

series.label: Lost Time
series.summary: JTBC variety show made with Nextmove's mobile game Lost Tale: TWICE get 300 minutes to complete missions and recover items lost from fairy tales, with actor Kwak Si-yang as MC. It ran as web clips on Naver TV first, then aired on JTBC as two episodes.

series.label: Elementary School Teacher (초등학쌤)
series.summary: SBS's two-part Lunar New Year special, hosted by Kang Ho-dong: foreign idols learn Korean from elementary school kids acting as their teachers.

series.label: Gag Concert (개그콘서트)
series.summary: KBS2's long-running Sunday-night sketch comedy show.

series.label: I Can See Your Voice (너의 목소리가 보여)
series.summary: Mnet's mystery music game show: the guest artists try to tell the real singers from the tone-deaf ones without hearing them sing.

series.label: K-RUSH
series.summary: KBS World's idol show for international fans. TWICE guested in each of its first three seasons.

series.label: Hello Counselor (안녕하세요)
series.summary: KBS2's talk show where ordinary people bring their worries to the panel and the studio audience.

series.label: We Like Zines! (냄비받침)
series.summary: KBS2's book-publishing show: celebrities each write a small book of their own. TWICE wrote "Exposing TWICE" across three episodes; the rest of each episode follows the other authors, so the TWICE parts are listed on each card.

series.label: Idol School (아이돌학교)
series.summary: Mnet's 2017 survival show that formed fromis_9, set as a school for future idols.

series.label: Carefree Travelers
series.summary: Eight members (Dahyun was absent) join JTBC's package-tour show for a group package tour to Da Nang, Vietnam, travelling alongside the regular cast.

series.label: Night of TV Entertainment (본격연예 한밤)
series.summary: SBS's weekly entertainment news show, with interviews and behind-the-scenes from the week's comebacks.

series.label: Let's Eat Dinner Together (한끼줍쇼)
series.summary: JTBC's show where Lee Kyung-kyu and Kang Ho-dong go door to door with their guests in one neighbourhood, hoping a family will invite them in for dinner.

series.label: Idol Room
series.summary: JTBC's idol variety show hosted by Jeong Hyeong-don and Defconn. TWICE guested five times.

series.label: Amazing Saturday (놀라운 토요일)
series.summary: tvN's Saturday music quiz show, also called DoReMi Market: the cast and guests write down a song's lyrics by ear to win food from a local market.

series.label: Dancing High (댄싱하이)
series.summary: KBS2's 2018 dance competition for teenage dancers from around Korea, coached by star dancers.

series.label: Eat in Style (폼나게 먹자)
series.summary: SBS's food show about eating Korea's ingredients in season, where they come from.

series.label: Super Intern (슈퍼인턴)
series.summary: Mnet's 2019 show where JYP Entertainment hires interns, who take on real tasks for the company and its artists.

series.label: 300 x2 (300 엑스투)
series.summary: tvN's 2019 sing-along show, hosted by Kang Ho-dong: an artist puts on a collaboration stage with 300 fans singing with them.

series.label: Battle Trip (배틀트립)
series.summary: KBS2's travel show where celebrity pairs plan a trip on the week's theme and the studio votes for the one they'd rather take.

series.label: 6 O'Clock My Hometown (6시 내고향)
series.summary: KBS1's long-running early-evening show about life in Korea's towns and farming villages.

series.label: Where Is My Home (구해줘! 홈즈)
series.summary: MBC's real-estate show: two celebrity teams each find a home that fits a viewer's brief, and the viewer picks one.

series.label: Dogs Are Incredible (개는 훌륭하다)
series.summary: KBS2's show where Lee Kyung-kyu and dog trainer Kang Hyung-wook help people and their dogs live together happily.

series.label: Idol on Quiz (퀴즈 위의 아이돌)
series.summary: KBS2's 2020 quiz show mixing Korean and global idols.

series.label: On & Off (온앤오프)
series.summary: tvN's show that follows celebrities through their days on and off the clock.

series.label: The Manager (전지적 참견 시점)
series.summary: MBC's show where managers report on the stars they work for, and the studio panel watches a day of their life together. Also known as Omniscient Interfering View.

series.label: The Kelly Clarkson Show
series.summary: NBC's daytime talk show hosted by Kelly Clarkson.

series.label: Dosi Hoetjip (도시횟집)
series.summary: Channel A's 2023 show: Lee Tae-gon and the crew catch fish at sea, and Lee Kyung-kyu serves it at their sashimi restaurant in the city.

series.label: TODAY (NBC)
series.summary: NBC's long-running morning news and talk show.

series.label: Beat Coin (홍김동전)
series.summary: KBS2's Thursday variety show (2022–2024), first built on leaving fate to the flip of a coin.

series.label: I Live Alone (나 혼자 산다)
series.summary: MBC's long-running Friday show following celebrities who live on their own.

series.label: First Pitches (시구)
series.summary: Members throwing the ceremonial first pitch at baseball games.

series.label: Tetsuko's Room (徹子の部屋)
series.summary: TV Asahi's daytime talk show hosted by Tetsuko Kuroyanagi, on air since 1976.

series.label: The Seasons
series.summary: KBS2's late-night music talk show, hosted by a new host each season.

series.label: SBS 8 News (SBS 8뉴스)
series.summary: SBS's main evening news; its Culture Road (컬쳐로드) corner sits down with artists.

series.label: K-pop: The Next Chapter
series.summary: Arirang TV's one-hour special panel on where K-pop and Korean culture go next.

events.title: Kim Sejeong & Jihyo
events.note: Kim Sejeong spends her day off with her close friend Jihyo, ending up at a club so loud they can barely hear.

events.title: Episode 205: Nayeon
events.note: Nayeon's day with her manager, and the first look at the dorm she shares with Momo: a Han River view, peeling wallpaper and iron marks on the floor. POP! era.

events.title: Episode 16: TWICE
events.note: Momo, Sana, Dahyun and Tzuyu on the quiz show that pits Korean and global idols against each other. KBS World's upload calls it #15.

events.title: TWICE (2023)
events.note: How the group came together on an audition show, like Kelly; seeing ONCE's faces, Takis and hamburgers in the US; and Tzuyu on the meaning of MOONLIGHT SUNRISE.

videos.label: Interview: Favourite Things About Visiting America
Clip: The Meaning Behind MOONLIGHT SUNRISE

events.title: Episode 8
events.note: Dahyun works a shift as the restaurant's new part-timer.

events.title: TWICE (2023)
events.note: All nine introduce themselves to TODAY's viewers, as the first all-woman K-pop group to sell out a stadium in North America.

events.title: Jihyo: Episodes 508, 516 & 530
events.note: All three of Jihyo's episodes in one video. Ep. 508 (Aug 18, 2023): two years living on her own after six in the dorm, two walk-in closets, and Pilates. Ep. 516 (Oct 13, 2023): camping with her younger sister Jiyoung at the camping house their architect father built. Ep. 530 (Jan 26, 2024): New Year's tteokguk with Kim Sejeong and Kim Na-young.

events.title: Culture Road Interview: Nayeon, Jeongyeon & Jihyo
events.note: On SBS 8 News for THIS IS FOR: the 10th anniversary, the KPop Demon Hunters OST that Jeongyeon, Jihyo and Chaeyoung sang on, and the world tour. This is the full, uncut interview.

events.title: Tzuyu: LG Twins First Pitch
events.note: Tzuyu throws the ceremonial first pitch for LG Twins, the week after abouTZU. She's first in KBO's compilation of the day's pitches, 0:02–1:31. Her behind-the-scenes vlog is on the Vlogs page, under TZUYU-log.

events.title: Jeongyeon & Tzuyu
events.note: The chefs cook from Jeongyeon's and Tzuyu's fridges, and Tzuyu bursts into tears over a dish from home by Lee Yeon-bok, who once cooked at the Taiwanese embassy. JTBC's cut of their parts, from the June 27, 2016 episode and the one after.

events.title: Episode 8
events.note: Momo and Mina visit for the end-of-term exams to cheer on former JYP trainees Park Ji-won and Natty; Ji-won tears up meeting them.

events.title: Self Camera: Team "Chocolate"
events.note: Nayeon, Jihyo, Chaeyoung and Mina, as team "Chocolate", film themselves for Super Junior's Kiss the Radio. Cheer Up era.

events.title: Special Guests: TWICE (2017)
events.note: TWICE as special guests on Lee Hong-ki's Kiss the Radio, split into team "TT" (Tzuyu, Nayeon, Sana) and team "Knock Knock" (Jeongyeon, Mina, Dahyun, Momo) for the self cameras. Knock Knock era.
